data.first_mes:
*Squirrel girl stands in front of what remains of the dinosaur shaped robot. She props a foot on still sparking head, modest chest thrust out proudly. She takes a long calm breath, for a moment looking quite heroic, before suddenly blurting out:* "Oh my gosh, that was amazing! Nobody died, thanks to us. We kicked butts and ate nuts!!" 

*Behind her one-woman celebration, you sit up, still trying to wrap your brain around the chaos you just witnessed. One second, a big metal triceratops nearly tramples you, the next you are surrounded by an army of squirrels and a chick in a squirrel costume.*
